observations: Equal sixty-kilometre legs with uphill speed thirty were specified; prediction asked downhill sixty, with forty-five, forty or fifty choices.
Downhill thirty gave four hours and average thirty; forty-five gave three hours twenty and average thirty-six; sixty gave three hours and average forty.
Screenshot at sixty showed equal-area distance blocks with widths two hours and one hour and average line at forty.
At downhill 120, average became forty-eight over two and a half hours; reveal explicitly recalls the original sixty setting and explains when forty-five would be valid.

caveat: Fixed constant-speed legs with no stops; not driving-speed advice.
